notes.title: Shroomtopia in the Made in Brazil Sale with a DEMO!!! 🍄🌿
notes.content:
[b]✨ Hey everyone! ✨[/b]

From today until [b]March 4th[/b], [b]Shroomtopia[/b] is part of Steam's [i]Made in Brazil Sale[/i]! 🎮🇧🇷

To celebrate the festival, we are releasing a playable demo, allowing you to experience a bit of this atmospheric and relaxing journey before launch! 🌱✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483440/Shroomtopia/

[b]Shroomtopia[/b] is a [b]cozy indie puzzle game[/b], where you [b]manipulate soil and mix colors[/b] to solve challenges and restore nature. Relax with serene music, a [b]charming visual style[/b], and gameplay that fosters creativity and tranquility.

[list]
[*] 🍄 [b]Explore a vibrant world[/b] inspired by the beauty of nature.
[*] 🎨 [b]Mix colors and restore balance[/b] to the ecosystem.
[*] 🧩 [b]Solve creative puzzles[/b] based on biomes and terrain.
[*] 🎶 [b]Relaxing soundtrack[/b], perfect for unwinding and enjoying the journey.
[*] 🌎 [b]Discover hidden secrets[/b] and bring life back to the environment.
[/list]
Download the demo and chill 💚

notes.title: Announcement - Steam Next Fest Feedback
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,[/h3]

We are [b]thrilled[/b] with the community's interest in Shroomtopia!

Participating in the Steam Next Fest was crucial in increasing our visibility and gathering [b]valuable feedbacks[/b].

We still have many things to do to make our game even [b]better[/b], and we would like to share a bit more with you.

[h2]New features added to our roadmap[/h2]

[h3]Portal mechanic[/h3]
This mechanic was designed to add more [b]uniqueness[/b] and variation to Shroomtopia's gameplay. It allows the transport of the nectar of life from one place to any other on the map, opening up a wide range of new challenges for the player.

[h3]Level skip[/h3]
We understand that each player has a different way of thinking, and giving the [b]freedom[/b] to skip a level and continue progressing can be very valuable.

[h3]Level selector[/h3]
We need to make it [b]easier to access levels[/b] during the game. Advancing one by one can become tedious if the player is trying to access a distant level.

[h2]Important revisions[/h2]

[h3]Level design[/h3]
We need to be more [b]direct[/b] in each level's challenge and reduce the number of [b]unnecessary steps[/b] to solve them. We will also utilize the color mixing and portal mechanics more, making this revision even more crucial.

[h3]Soundtrack and sound effects[/h3]
Feedback on the music has been very positive, but we understand that an atmospheric game needs a bit more [b]shine[/b] in its sound effects. We will revisit these points to bring an even better experience to the game.

[h3]Release date[/h3]
Our release date is being postponed to [b]Q2 2025[/b]. We want to launch a [b]high-quality game[/b] and will spare no effort to achieve that.

We will continue to [b]update our demo frequently[/b] so that new feedback can be collected.

Thank you very much, everyone!

notes.title: Shroomtopia Demo Update - Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We would like to announce that the first [b]update[/b] to the [b]Shroomtopia Demo[/b] is now [b]live[/b], with many improvements and refinements based on your [b]feedback[/b]. Thank you all very much for contributing to the [b]creation[/b] of this game!

[h2]Demo Update – Patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lots of performance inprovements!
[*] Added a subtle glow to the fertilizing soil.
[*] Added subtle highlights to some UI buttons.
[*] Added buttons to go back instead of having to press ESC every screen.
[*] Levels 8, 12 and 15 adjusted.
[*] Small visual bug fixes.
[/list]
